tasks.title: Document shared component and content conventions
tasks.spec: ## Repository: website — Files, proposed entry, checks and completion evidence; Required behavior: The common entry; Acceptance evidence 1-3, 5-6; Non-goals, Risks and impact statements. Document reuse of src/components/, src/lib/ and src/build/ without changing those modules. Components and content logic stay small pure functions of props; I/O stays in scripts/ and src/build/. Preserve the existing done gate: run bun run check:all (AGENTS.md:23; package.json:19,25-26), including the site build, links, budget and a11y. If check:site cannot run locally, report the concrete network/Chromium limitation, the bun run check result and green CI job site (.github/workflows/ci.yml:19-35). No README change. Add ## Code conventions directly after ## Code design; extend a section already present on current main instead of adding a duplicate. Re-read current main before editing (inspected clone d5e725f); apply the Counterexamples to the entry.

acceptance.expected: prints exactly AGENTS.md; no product code, test, CI, dependency, README.md, version or generated-output changes
empty output, grep exits 1: no existing lines removed
prints an integer at least 1; the exact canonical meta URL is present
prints exactly 200 for an unauthenticated request

Reading confirms: Add ## Code conventions directly after ## Code design; extend a section already present on current main instead of adding a duplicate. The entry names src/components/, src/lib/ and src/build/; it requires searching before writing, extracting the second copy into a shared helper, and small pure functions with effects at the existing boundary. Common prose is at most three lines after the heading. It links the convention without copying its seven rules or examples, preserves all existing text and stricter rules, and adds no enforcement or refactor.

exit 0: package.json:26 runs check (lint, typecheck, unit tests; line 25) and check:site (build, links, budget, a11y; line 19), as required by AGENTS.md:23. If network access or Playwright Chromium prevents local check:site, record the concrete reason, bun run check result and green PR CI job site (.github/workflows/ci.yml:19-35); do not waive the site gate or change tooling.
no changed or untracked path except AGENTS.md (or empty output after committing); in particular no dist/, lockfile, test or tooling changes

The PR body names the issue and supplies the AGENTS.md-only diff, link/heading grep outputs, and the bun run check:all command and actual result (or bun run check result, the named local check:site blocker and green CI job site). It records known limits; states documentation-only performance impact none expected and security impact no; and leaves Acceptance evidence 6 as a post-merge feature-close check with the main SHA and repeated link/meaning checks, without claiming it ran before merge.

acceptance.command: verified_main_sha=$(gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-website/commits/main --jq .sha) && printf '%s\n' "$verified_main_sha" && gh api "repos/lorenzh/pulse-website/contents/AGENTS.md?ref=$verified_main_sha" --jq .content | base64 --decode
acceptance.expected: Deferred until feature close after this target PR merges (not a pre-merge task gate): record the main commit SHA returned by GitHub and read AGENTS.md at that exact SHA. Repeat Acceptance evidence 2-3 on that content: canonical URL present at least once, exactly 1 Code conventions heading, URL HTTP 200, and the three meanings. This implements this target's part of Acceptance evidence 6.
